notes.title: Amputea V1.1 now available!
notes.content:
Amputea теперь доступен на русском языке!
Amputea está agora disponível em Português!
Amputea est maintenant disponible en français!
Amputea ist jetzt verfügbar in Deutsch!
Amputea现在可以在中国！
Amputea está ahora disponible en español!

Also includes 4 new achievements and a bunch of bug fixes!

More details over at : http://steamcommunity.com/app/289090/discussions/0/522728813963002343/
